scope: Independent review of changed production Whole encoder/probe, warm selector, parent-authored exact-source build guard, Cargo pins and associated tests. Harness/workflow excluded from this content verdict and assigned separate cross-author review.
checks: Byte-minimum preservation: the actual first-block certificate runs only after static pruning and only when its maximum possible certificate could exclude Whole. Monotone chunk-framing cost and original Raw/Whole/Sparse/Schema tuple priority preserve earlier Whole ties; inconclusive shape/bound or disabled guard executes unchanged compress2.

Certificate parser checks bounded input length, exact12-byte output, exactly128KiB consumed, magic/flags, full content length, legal nonfinal first block and nonzero bounded payload. Raw/RLE decoded size must equal128KiB. The bound counts actual first payload, checksum and minimum remaining block headers; it does not assume future payload compression or use destination-too-small as evidence.

Pinned bundled implementation inspected at compress2/stream initialization, direct-versus-buffered output, internal compressBound(block)+1 workspace, first unsplit block, and block-local LDM/dfast limits. Both paths use full-source End parameter selection. Only the first-block size relation is relied on; no full streaming-frame equivalence is assumed.

Both pre/post probe resets are explicit; codec/reset/resource errors propagate. Workspace drift drops the context. Probe returns only an integer bound, never candidate bytes. Winning frames, target/base identity, consuming client, receiver authorization, exact reconstruction and durable publication remain unchanged.

Exact source guard independently rehashed90 bundled C/header/build files. Direct pinned zstd-sys vendored metadata and exact include shape bind the tree; missing/mutated/foreign source, explicit pkg-config, known CFLAGS forms, disabled baseline and numeric version mismatch disable optimization. Cargo rerun directives cover used target/host CFLAGS and source changes.

All checked arithmetic is bounded by the preexisting16MiB admission limit; certificate length stays below132KiB, chunk-cost computation allocates no encoded payload, and private context ownership prevents concurrent mutation. No new unsafe block, network input parser, capability bypass or secret handling was introduced.

Existing recorded tests include actual behavioral RED, enabled/disabled paths, malformed header rejection, block boundaries, random/zero/structured/mixed first/tail inputs,40 repeated probe-to-full exact frame checks, all four selector winners, target/base limits and tie behavior. Post-lint guard/example39pass and360-test full qualification are retained; reviewer performed no rerun.
limitations: Correctness review is scoped to the exact guarded bundled source and unchanged codec parameters; disabled or unavailable profiles retain the full encoder. No proof of arbitrary streaming/one-shot byte equivalence is claimed.
Native allocator/reset failure branches were not newly fault-injected; existing recorded coverage explicitly excludes branch/MC/DC and complete build-script flow coverage.

No performance or WAN result is approved here. The registered local ten-pair1MiB sender-CPU median ratio<=0.80 and all exact/frame checks must pass before WAN; compressible fallback control and all negative outcomes remain required.
